svg.text: The piece funnels from a definition into a historical chain of origins, converges onto evidence from many fields,
forks into two families of causes, then converges again into institutional response and reform.

g.text: Replication Crisis: Shape of the Argument
Definition and vocabulary funnel into a chain of historical origins, which converges on evidence from many fields,
forks into two families of causes, and converges again into response and reform.

g.title: Published findings often fail to reproduce — The replication crisis: widespread failure to reproduce published results undermines trust in findings. — → spya-pcnqxn

g.text: Eight independent fields of replication testing all point the same way, converging on one general finding — and then an
ironic twist: the papers that don't replicate get cited more, not less.

research is designed and analysed on the right.
